Mitigation included host isolation, DLL quarantine, PrintNightmare patches, network block, and credential resets.

arguments.summary: Privilege escalation on server 10.0.1.25 via PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-34527). Attacker leveraged a malicious DLL loaded by spoolsv.exe from C:\Windows\Temp, resulting in Domain Admin rights. Containment actions isolated the print server, blocked source IP 10.0.5.14, revoked service account, and reset user credentials. Eradication applied the PrintNightmare patch, removed the DLL, performed full endpoint scans, and hardened the server.

timeline.description: Alert triggered: privilege escalation detected on 10.0.1.25 (spoolsv.exe loading malicious.dll).
SOC analyst confirmed malicious DLL load and identified CVE-2021-34527 exploitation.

Revoked compromised service account svc_print_mgmt and reset password for user CORP\auser.
Eradication: removed malicious.dll, applied PrintNightmare patch, ran full endpoint scans.
Post‑incident hardening: disabled remote printer driver installation, enforced least‑privilege for print services.
